title: 第225章 问此间（五十三）
content_zh:
时隔万年,黎牧星再度化作人形，龙女形容枯槁，身不禁风,默默抚摸着额心残余的温度，除了一个吻,一场雨，一间牢笼的残骸，巫罗再没有给她留下什么。
就连原先送别的爱语，如今也变成了囚龙的凶术，时光消磨心意，蹉跎温情,以至最后使她口出咒言,使巫罗再也不能与她相见。
她望着自己的双手，面上的泪水始终不曾干涸，那白衣的男子望着她,缓声问道：“龙女,你日后要如何打算呢？”
黎牧星抬起眼睛,心中五味杂陈,嘴唇木愣愣地动了好几下,嗫嚅道：“……不知道。”
龙的寿数不见尽头,只要她愿意，就是在这里站上一百年,一千年，又有什么关系呢？她的爱消散了,恨亦是枉然的,总归世上再没有什么可以怀念的事物了。
有时候,黎牧星会无法避免地想起一个问题，当年万龙升空，举族离去，血亲却唯独丢下了她，是不是他们早已经预见了她命中与巫罗纠缠的这场大劫，所以才不愿她与他们有所牵连？
晏欢皱着眉头，抹平法衣上的褶皱，看见刘扶光的嘴唇印在另一个同族前额——即便知晓那是巫罗所托，他心底仍然泛起无法言喻的酸水。
“你又在伤心什么？”他居高临下，直接用龙语发问，“你的人类深爱你万年之久，为了你，他可以舍身断道，从身到心，毫无保留地给你，你还有什么不满足的？”
“彼之蜜糖，汝之砒霜，”她厉声道，“别把你的愿望强加在我身上！你说的又有什么好了？”
她望着眼前的古怪黑龙，一时之间，只觉一股贯穿心魂的恶寒，顺着鳞片上下乱窜。
她被困万年，无从得知晏欢的根脚，但她完全可以感知出，这只黑龙既无龙珠，又缺肉身，完全凭借魂力支撑现世，实在破碎到无以复加的程度。可他居然还没有死去，还能令她生出忌惮的神威。
“你又是什么东西，”黎牧星冷笑道，一腔痛慨怨恨，此刻都像找到了发泄口，“敢在我这里啰唣吵闹！”
晏欢亦笑出一口锋利瘆人的尖牙：“哦？区区应龙苗裔，竟也想要以下犯上了么？”
空气劈啪作响，宛如暴躁的雷霆相互擦碰，散发出令人窒息的威压，刘扶光一下插在两头虎视眈眈的龙中间，皱眉呵斥道：“好了，都住口！好不容易平息下来，真要打个你死我活才算完吗？”
晏欢与黎牧星交谈时，用的俱是龙语，漫天嘶吟宛如金石交错，刘扶光一句话也听不懂，但这不妨碍他看出那剑拔弩张的氛围。遭受他的斥责，晏欢缩起脖子，耳朵都耷拉了下来，黎牧星亦觉得心神震荡，不由退让。
“应龙女，”刘扶光转向黎牧星，“我受巫罗所托，他说你沉睡太久，尚不知世事如何，确实需要人帮忙牵引。我觉得，你定然不愿再在这里待下去，哪怕这里是他身化的世界……”
面对他，黎牧星下意识收起了满身尖锐的棘刺，不知为何，她居然愿意对着一名陌生人翻出一段肚皮。
她面容扭曲，喘息道：“谁说我不愿在这里待了！恰恰相反，我要沉毁陆地，打碎巫罗的每一块骨头，因为他怎么敢自作主张，以为我会感激他的牺牲！我要杀了所有众生，再把这颗星星改造成我的巢穴，再没有人能活下去，没有！”
“我永远不会忘记他们都做了什么……蠢笨不堪，竟妄言我与巫罗的往事，用人言篡改我的意识，称呼我为恶龙、孽种，而他们立足求生的万事万物，全是巫罗为我而生的！为了我！忘恩负义的东西，我定不轻饶他们，等到最后一个人也淹死在海水里，被鱼群吃干净，我的恨意才能削弱万分之一！”
应龙指天喊地，激烈地发着脾气，刘扶光望着她，只是忧愁地笑了笑。

“在这里筑巢？”他问，“可是，这里的海水，全是巫罗为你而流的泪啊。”
content_en:
After thousands of years, Li Muxing turned into a human form again. The dragon girl looked haggard, her body could not help but the wind, silently stroking the remaining warmth in her forehead. Except for a kiss, a rain, and the remains of a cage, Wu Luo left her nothing.
Even the original love words of farewell have now turned into a vicious trick to imprison the dragon. Time wears away her heart and wastes her tenderness, and finally makes her utter a curse so that Wu Luo can never see her again.
She looked at her hands, the tears on her face never dried up. The man in white looked at her and asked slowly: "Dragon Girl, what are your plans for the future?"
Li Muxing raised his eyes, with mixed feelings in his heart. His lips moved several times in a daze, and he muttered: "...I don't know."
The dragon's lifespan has no end. As long as she is willing, she can stand here for a hundred or a thousand years. What does it matter? Her love has dissipated, and her hatred is in vain. After all, there is nothing left to miss in the world.
Sometimes, Li Muxing can't help but think of a question. When Wanlong ascended into the sky and the whole family left, her blood relatives left her alone. Had they already foreseen the catastrophe that she was destined to be entangled with Wu Luo, so they didn't want her to be involved with them?
Yan Huan frowned, smoothed the wrinkles on his cassock, and saw Liu Fuguang's lips pressing on the forehead of another compatriot - even though he knew it was entrusted by Wu Luo, he still felt unspeakable sourness in his heart.
"Why are you sad again?" He asked condescendingly, speaking directly in dragon language, "Your human has loved you deeply for thousands of years. For you, he would sacrifice his life and give to you without any reservation. What else are you unsatisfied with?"
"He's honey, you're arsenic," she said sternly, "Don't impose your wishes on me! What else can you say?"
She looked at the strange black dragon in front of her, and for a moment, she felt a chill running through her heart and soul, running up and down along its scales.
She had been trapped for ten thousand years and had no way of knowing Yan Huan's origins, but she could completely sense that this black dragon had neither dragon balls nor a physical body. It relied entirely on its soul power to support its existence. It was truly broken beyond measure. But he was not dead yet, and he could still make her fearful.
"Who are you?" Li Muxing sneered, filled with bitter resentment. He seemed to have found an outlet at this moment, "How dare you make such a noise in my place!"
Yan Huan also smiled with sharp and terrifying fangs: "Oh? A mere descendant of Yinglong, actually want to commit the following crime?"
The air crackled, like violent thunders clashing with each other, exuding suffocating pressure. Liu Fuguang was inserted between the two dragons who were eyeing each other, frowning and scolding: "Okay, shut up! After finally calming down, do we really have to fight you to death?"
When Yan Huan and Li Muxing talked, they all spoke in dragon language, and the sound filled the sky like gold and stone intertwined. Liu Fuguang couldn't understand a word, but this did not prevent him from seeing the tense atmosphere. After being scolded by him, Yan Huan shrank his neck and drooped his ears. Li Muxing also felt his mind was shaken and couldn't help but give in.
"Ying Longnu," Liu Fuguang turned to Li Muxing, "I was entrusted by Wu Luo. He said that you have been sleeping for too long and don't know what's going on in the world. You really need someone to help guide you. I think you definitely don't want to stay here anymore, even if this is the world of his incarnation..."
Facing him, Li Muxing subconsciously put away the sharp thorns all over her body. For some reason, she was actually willing to turn over a piece of her belly in front of a stranger.
Her face was distorted and she gasped: "Who said I don't want to stay here anymore! On the contrary, I will destroy the land and break every bone of Wuluo, because how dare he act on his own and think that I will be grateful for his sacrifice! I will kill all living beings, and then transform this star into my lair. No one can survive, no one!"
"I will never forget what they did... so stupidly that theyThey lied about the past between me and Wu Luo, used human words to tamper with my consciousness, and called me an evil dragon and evil seed. However, all the things they relied on to survive were all created by Wu Luo for me! For me! I will not spare those ungrateful things lightly. Only when the last person is drowned in the sea and eaten up by a school of fish will my hatred be weakened by one ten thousandth! "
Ying Long pointed at the sky and shouted at the ground, losing his temper fiercely. Liu Fuguang looked at her and just smiled sadly.
“Nesting here? "He asked, "But the sea water here is full of tears shed by Wu Luo for you. "
